referrals.title: Referral Program
referrals.subtitle: The referral program is a completely optional feature. Your daily assignments, attendance, and primary payouts will not be affected whether you participate or not.
referrals.id_desc: Copy your unique referral ID below. Share it with someone who could benefit from our company, and start earning a referral commission on their generated incomes.
referrals.overview_p1: Instead of traditional advertising, we choose to reinvest our budget directly back into our community. When an eligible user (the "Referrer") successfully refers a new user (the "Referee"), the Referrer will earn a 20% referral commission based on the profits generated by the Referee.
referrals.overview_l1: This 20% referral commission is subsidized entirely by the Company.
referrals.overview_l2: The Referee retains 100% of their original commissions.
referrals.overview_l3: All earned referral commission are credited directly to the Referrer’s ledger balance.
referrals.mlm_desc: Our referral structure is strictly one-to-one (1-on-1). We do not support multi-level marketing (MLM) or tiered commission structures. The Referrer is entitled to commissions solely from the direct Referee they successfully referred. If the Referee subsequently refers a third party, the original Referrer earns no commission from that third-party user.
referrals.paused_desc: Referral commissions are active only when the Referee's account is in good standing. If a Referee leaves a assignment in a "pending" state, your 20% referral commission from their account will be paused. Any commissions that would have been generated during this paused state are forfeited and will not be released retroactively. Once the Referee clears their pending assignment, your 20% referral commission will immediately resume for all of their future completions.
referrals.eligibility_l1: Attendance Requirement: To protect the company integrity, a Referrer must have accumulated a total of 14 days of attendance since account creation before they are authorized to generate or share a referral ID.
referrals.eligibility_l2: Cooldown Period: To ensure high-quality referrals, links may only be shared with one individual at a time. Upon successfully linking a new Referee, the Referrer is placed on a 14-day cooldown period before being permitted to refer another user.
referrals.eligibility_l3: Fraud & Account Bans: Program abuse, including creating multiple accounts for self-referral or utilizing fraudulent methods, is strictly prohibited. Violations will result in the immediate forfeiture of all commission earnings and a permanent ban of all associated accounts.

rewards.coach_restricted: Attendance payouts, membership bonuses and referral program are not applicable to coach accounts.
rewards.welcome_desc: As a new member, a $20.00 Welcome Bonus has been automatically credited to your available balance upon registration. This bonus is provided to give you a head start on your earnings and is added directly to your standard balance.
rewards.salary_desc: Complete daily assignments to reach your upcoming payout milestones.
rewards.perfect_desc:
Consistency pays off. Complete all {days} daily assignments within the current month to achieve the Full Attendance KPI. This automatically applies a +15% Base Payout Multiplier to your earnings for the cycle.

How it works: The multiplier is applied exclusively to your accumulated base payouts. For example, if your total base payouts amount to $1,200, the +15% multiplier will add an extra $180, bringing your final base payout total to $1,380. (Note: Other earnings are calculated separately and are not affected by this multiplier).
rewards.promo_desc: Bonus events are special, temporary opportunities that occasionally occur. When active, they appear here for a limited duration to give you a chance to earn exclusive rewards. Check back periodically before they expire!

ENGAGEMENT AND COMPLIANCE

Our system experiences frequent updates, with products being added and removed every minute, and prolonged holding of a product by a user can adversely affect merchant progress. Users are encouraged to complete their product cycles and submit payout requests within a timeframe of 24 to 48 hours.

In the event that a product is retained for longer than the specified 48-hour period, our terms of service provide for adjustments to the standard payment schedules based on mutual agreement between the user and our company. Should such adjustments occur, nominal fees may be levied to cover the administrative costs associated with these changes and to ensure continuous service provision.

Furthermore, Accounts are mandated to complete an assigned product cycle within a forty-eight (48) hour timeframe to ensure the efficacy of real-time data collection.

Under no circumstances may distributed products be canceled, deleted, or skipped.

Conversely, the commission rate applied to package products is set at a fixed 5%. Access to special premium products is strictly restricted to Exclusive and VIP Account tiers.

Product distribution is algorithmically randomized based on the Account's available asset balance; a higher asset balance correlates with an increased probability of receiving higher-priced product allocations. Should an Account execute a single qualifying deposit while actively uploading products, and concurrently meet the prerequisites of an active promotional event, the Account shall automatically be upgraded to the specified membership tier.

In the event an Account’s asset balance remains in an outstanding (or shortfall) state for an extended duration, the Company reserves the right to suspend the Account in accordance with established internal policies. Commission settlements shall only be calculated and formally credited to an Account’s asset balance when said balance is in a positive state.

Specifically, Accounts whose asset balance is in an outstanding or negative state are strictly ineligible to receive the 20% referral commission generated from their sub-accounts or direct referrals. During any period in which the balance remains outstanding, all commission settlements shall be temporarily suspended. Upon the successful restoration of the Account’s asset balance to a positive state, standard commission payments will resume in accordance with the Platform’s standard settlement procedures.

Please note that following this restoration, only commissions generated after the balance is corrected will be calculated; commissions originating from products completed during the outstanding period shall be forfeited and will not be retroactively credited.

b. Premium Accounts are authorized to process payouts up to a maximum limit of $50,000.

c. Exclusive Accounts are authorized to process payouts up to a maximum limit of $100,000.

d. VIP Accounts operate with an unlimited payout capacity.

In the event that an authorized payout request exceeds the $100,000 threshold, the Account shall be required to submit a mandatory insurance fee prior to the execution of the transaction. privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content:
At The Structured Data Company, we’re strongly committed to protecting and respecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy ("Privacy Policy") covers your access and use of this website (the "Website") as well as associated content, software, and mobile applications (collectively, the "Service"). This Privacy Policy explains when, why, and how we collect and use personal information about the businesses and everyday users who visit our Website or use our Services, the conditions under which we may disclose your personal information to others, and how we keep your personal information secure. We may change this Privacy Policy from time to time. By using our Website or our Services, you are agreeing to be bound by this Privacy Policy. Please read this Policy carefully. We are committed to protecting your privacy through our compliance with the terms of this Policy.

GLOBAL APPLICABILITY & JURISDICTIONS
We operate internationally. Regardless of where our headquarters are located, we are committed to complying with the applicable privacy laws and regulations of the country or region from which you access our Services (such as the GDPR for users in the European Economic Area, or the CCPA for users in California). Your rights regarding your personal data will be respected in accordance with your local jurisdiction.

CHANGES
The Company ("we" or "us") can modify this privacy policy, and if we make material changes to it, we will provide notice through our services, or by other means, to provide you the opportunity to review the changes before they become effective. If you object to any changes, you may close your account. You acknowledge that your continued use of our services after we publish or send a notice about our changes to this privacy policy means that the collection, use, and sharing of your personal data is subject to the updated privacy policy as of its effective date.

CREATE ACCOUNT
To create an account as a business or an everyday user, you need to provide data, including your email address and/or mobile number, your year of birth to verify your age, and a self-setup password. When collecting personal information, we collect it within the necessary limits, and the collection will be carried out with a priority to ensure legality and fairness.

INFORMATION WE COLLECT
We may collect your personal information from you directly or from other entities with whom we work, such as merchants, users, government authorities, public or government agencies, or our own the Company. Personal Information we collect, use, and disclose includes:

a. Contact information, such as your name, email address, and contact number;

b. Identity information such as your nationality;

c. Year of birth, which is required to verify your age;

d. Information required under applicable laws and regulations, professional obligations, internal policies and risk management procedures, such as record-keeping obligations, fraud prevention, audit purposes, compliance screening and due diligence, sanctions regime and court order, whether in any eligible Regions or elsewhere;

e. Information relating to info-communication technology systems and processes, office equipment and facilities; and

f. Photographs and other audio-visual information.

If you are submitting the personal information of another individual to us, you confirm that it is true and correct, that all necessary consents have been obtained, or that you are otherwise permitted to provide such personal information to us.

HOW WE USE YOUR PERSONAL INFORMATION
How we use your personal information will depend on which services you use, how you use those services, and the choices you make in your settings. We use the information that we have about you to provide and personalize our services, including with the help of automated systems and inferences we make, so that our services (including ads) can be more relevant and useful to you and others. We may also use your information to occasionally send you product updates to keep you informed about changes or improvements to our Services.

DATA SHARING AND THIRD-PARTY TOOLS
We will never sell your personal data. However, to operate our Services effectively, we do share data with authorized third-party Service Providers who help us run our platform. These providers are strictly limited to using your data only as necessary to perform their services for us. Our core third-party tools include:

a. Google Analytics: For understanding how users interact with our Website to improve user experience.

b. XE Currency Converter: To provide accurate, real-time currency conversion rates within our platform.

c. LiveChat: To facilitate real-time user support and communication.

d. Cloudflare: For website security, performance optimization, and web analytics.

COLLECTION AND USE OF PAYMENT INFORMATION FOR PAYOUTS
1. Information We Collect for Payouts
To process and deliver requested payouts to you, we collect necessary financial and transactional information. Depending on your chosen payout method, this may include:

a. Bank account details (e.g., account number, routing number, IBAN, SWIFT code).

b. Third-party payment service details (e.g., PayPal email address).

c. Billing address and full legal name associated with the financial account.

d. Tax identification numbers or relevant documentation, where legally required for compliance and reporting.

2. Purpose of Collection
We collect and process this information strictly for the following purposes:

a. To fulfill and execute your payout requests.

b. To prevent fraudulent activity, money laundering, and unauthorized transactions.

c. To comply with local and international financial regulations, tax laws, and accounting standards.

3. Data Sharing and Third-Party Processors
We do not sell your financial information. Your payment details are strictly confidential. We only share this data with authorized, secure third-party payment gateways, banking institutions, and financial service providers solely for the purpose of executing the payout transaction. These partners are legally and contractually obligated to protect your data and are compliant with strict financial security standards (such as PCI-DSS).

4. International Data Transfers (Global & GDPR Compliance)
Because we operate internationally, your payment data may be transferred to, processed, or stored in countries outside of your country of residence, including the United States. We implement appropriate legal safeguards, such as Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) and robust encryption, to ensure your financial data receives the same level of protection globally as it does under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) or your local jurisdiction.

5. United States Privacy Rights (Including CCPA/CPRA)
For residents of the United States, including California, we respect your rights regarding your personal and financial data. We affirm that:

a. We collect your financial data solely for the business purpose of completing your requested transactions.

b. We do not "sell" or "share" your financial data for cross-context behavioral advertising.

c. You have the right to request the deletion of your payment data; however, please note that federal and state financial laws may require us to securely retain specific transaction records for a designated period (e.g., for tax and anti-fraud purposes) before they can be permanently deleted.

PROTECTION OF YOUR PERSONAL INFORMATION
We use appropriate technical, organizational, and administrative security measures to protect your personal information from any loss, misuse, or unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction. We also limit access to your personal information to those who have a genuine business need to know. Personal information is being put under appropriate administration with required and reasonable protective measures under way to guard against unfair access, loss, falsification, leakage, etc. from the perspective of proper information technology and administration. However, there are always risks involved with providing personal information, as no technology is completely risk-free or can be guaranteed to be 100% secure. If any negligence in administration were to occur, such as leakage of such data, we would be in a position to take immediate and effective countermeasures as far as possible.

RETENTION OF YOUR PERSONAL INFORMATION
We will not hold your personal information for any period longer than we believe is reasonably necessary for the purposes it was collected for, or for such a longer period as is required for business or legal purposes. When destroying your personal information, we will take commercially reasonable measures to make your personal information irrecoverable or irreproducible in accordance with the applicable law.

COOKIE AND SIMILAR TECHNOLOGIES
As further described in our Cookie Policy, we use cookies and similar technologies (e.g., pixels and ad tags) to collect data (e.g., device IDs) to recognize you and your device(s) on, off, and across different services and devices where you have engaged with our services. We also allow some others to use cookies as described in our Cookie Policy.

SECURITY
We implement security safeguards designed to protect your data, such as HTTPS. We regularly monitor our systems for possible vulnerabilities and attacks. However, we cannot warrant the security of any information that you send us. There is no guarantee that data may not be accessed, disclosed, altered, or destroyed by breach of any of our physical, technical, or managerial safeguards.

DO NOT TRACK SIGNALS
We currently do not share personal data with third parties for their direct marketing purposes without your permission.

REVIEW OF PRIVACY POLICY
This portal will not be publicly acknowledged and will be kept strictly confidential in order to prevent leaks of merchants' confidential information.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.content:
1. INTRODUCTION
At the Company, we believe in being completely clear, transparent, and open about how we collect, use, and safeguard data related to you. This Cookie Policy applies to any the Company product, website, or service that links to this policy or incorporates it by reference. In the spirit of transparency, this comprehensive policy provides detailed information about how, when, and why we use cookies and similar technologies.

By continuing to visit or use our services, you are acknowledging and agreeing to the use of cookies and similar technologies for the strictly necessary, functional, and third-party purposes described in this policy.

2. WHAT ARE COOKIES AND SIMILAR TECHNOLOGIES?
To provide a seamless and secure experience, we utilize specific web technologies. These include:

Cookies: Cookies are small text files containing a unique string of characters that are downloaded to and stored on your computer, tablet, or mobile device when you visit a website. They uniquely identify your browser or device, allowing the website to recognize you upon your return.

Local Storage: Local storage is an industry-standard technology that enables a website or application to store information locally on your device's browser. We use local storage to apply your specific website preferences seamlessly without relying on traditional cookies.

3. LIFESPAN OF OUR TECHNOLOGIES
The length of time a cookie or local storage token stays on your device depends on whether it is a "persistent" or "session" technology.

Session Technologies: These are temporary and only last as long as your current browsing session. They expire and are automatically deleted when you close your web browser.

Persistent Technologies: These last beyond the current session and remain in your browser until they expire or until you manually delete them. Persistent technologies are used to recognize you as an existing user, making it easier to return to the Company and interact with our services without needing to sign in or reset your preferences again.

4. HOW AND WHY WE USE THESE TECHNOLOGIES
Our use of cookies and local storage is focused on making the website function properly for you, securing your account, and providing essential customer support. The technologies we use fall into three specific categories:

A. Strictly Necessary Technologies (Authentication & Security)
These technologies are essential for the core operation of our services. Without them, the website cannot function properly. We use these technologies to:
a. Recognize you when you visit our services.
b. Verify your account and authenticate your login session, you do not have to log in repeatedly as you navigate between different pages.
c. Enable and support our core security features.
d. Help us detect malicious activity, prevent fraud, and keep your account safe.

B. Functional Technologies (User Preferences)
These technologies allow our website to remember choices you make and provide an enhanced, more personalized experience. We use local storage and cookies specifically to:
a. Remember your interface preferences, such as your selection of Dark Mode or Light Mode.
b. Store your language selections.
c. Speed up site functionality and ensure the website loads exactly how you prefer it, bypassing the need to readjust your settings on every single visit.

C. Third-Party Integrations
To provide the best possible experience, we integrate specific tools provided by trusted third-party companies. These third parties may set their own cookies on your device when you interact with their features on our website. These include:
a. LiveChat: We use LiveChat to provide real-time customer support. LiveChat uses cookies to maintain your chat session as you navigate across different pages on our website, ensuring you do not lose your conversation with our support team.
b. XE Currency Converter: We utilize XE to provide accurate, real-time currency conversions. This tool may use temporary session data to fetch live exchange rates, but it does not use persistent cookies to track or store your currency preferences across browsing sessions.

5. OUR PRIVACY COMMITMENT: NO MARKETING OR ADVERTISING TRACKERS
While we use third-party tools for essential website functionality and customer support, we believe your data is your own. As explicitly stated in our Privacy Policy, we do not sell your personal information. Furthermore, we do not use any third-party targeting cookies, advertising cookies, or marketing pixels on our website to track your behavior for ad retargeting.

6. HOW TO MANAGE AND CONTROL YOUR COOKIES
You have the right to decide whether to accept or reject cookies. Most web browsers inherently allow you to control cookies through their settings preferences. Furthermore, most browsers also enable you to review and erase cookies, including the Company cookies, at any time.

Because the means by which you can refuse cookies through your web browser controls vary from browser to browser, you should visit your browser's help menu for more information. Here is how you can manage cookies on popular browsers:
a. Google Chrome: Go to Settings > Privacy and security > Cookies and other site data.
b. Mozilla Firefox: Go to Settings > Privacy & Security > Cookies and Site Data.
c. Apple Safari: Go to Preferences > Privacy > Cookies and website data.
d. Microsoft Edge: Go to Settings > Cookies and site permissions > Manage and delete cookies and site data.

Please note: If you choose to reject or disable cookies, certain parts of the Company products may not work properly. Specifically, you may be unable to stay logged into your account, your custom display preferences will not be saved, and your customer support chat sessions may be interrupted.

7. CHANGES TO THIS COOKIE POLICY
We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time in order to reflect, for example, changes to the cookies we use or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. Please revisit this Cookie Policy regularly to stay informed about our use of cookies and related technologies.

8. CONTACT US
If you have any questions about our use of cookies or other technologies, please refer to our main Privacy Policy or contact our support team.

items.question: Do I need coding experience to use the platform?
items.answer: No coding experience is required. We have designed the platform with intuitive dashboards and visual product builders that allow you to manage, synchronize, and upload complex data structures without writing a single line of code. Our goal is to make advanced data processing accessible to everyday users.

items.question: How does the AI entity detection work?
items.answer: Our proprietary AI-powered intelligence engine automatically analyzes incoming raw data properties and proactively suggests the correct product types, relationship mappings, and property labels. This significantly reduces the need for manual data entry, minimizes human error, and speeds up your ability to complete daily assignments.

items.question: Is there a mobile app available?
items.answer: While we do not have a standalone downloadable app, our platform is fully web-based and highly optimized for both desktop and mobile browsers. We chose a web-first approach to ensure that critical security patches and system updates are deployed to all users instantly, allowing you to seamlessly manage your dashboard from any device with a stable internet connection.

items.question: What exactly is a "Product" in the context of this platform?
items.answer: A product is a structured framework that defines how raw, unstructured data is organized, connected, and understood by machines. Our merchant partners require perfectly structured data to train their models and organize their catalogs. Our platform processes these semantic products to ensure data integrity before they are validated and uploaded to the financial ledger.

items.question: Do you offer a public API for developers?
items.answer: Currently, our platform operates entirely through our visual web dashboard and we do not offer a public API for consumer accounts. Dedicated API integration is strictly restricted to our approved institutional and merchant partners to maintain the integrity of our allocation pool and prevent unauthorized external scraping.

items.question: Can I use automated bots or scripts to complete my assignments?
items.answer: No. The use of automated bots, scripts, macros, or any other unauthorized software to complete assignments is strictly prohibited. Our merchants pay for authentic human oversight during the validation process. Engaging in automated activities will immediately trigger our anti-fraud systems, resulting in a permanent account ban and the forfeiture of all generated earnings.

items.question: Do you offer webhooks for real-time ledger balance notifications?
items.answer: No, we currently do not offer webhooks or public API endpoints for real-time ledger notifications. To ensure maximum security of your financial data, we utilize a closed-loop system. You must log into your authenticated dashboard directly to monitor your balance, upcoming milestones, and recent transactional activity.

items.question: Who is eligible to use the platform?
items.answer: To comply with strict international financial regulations and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) policies, users must be at least 18 years of age. Additionally, you must reside in one of our supported operational regions, which currently include the United Kingdom, United States, Canada, Europe, Japan, South Korea, Singapore, Spain, Hong Kong, or Thailand.

items.question: Are there any upfront fees to join?
items.answer: No, creating an account is completely free and there are absolutely no hidden sign-up charges. Our platform generates revenue through the successful processing of product data for our merchant partners, not by charging our users an entry fee.

items.question: What is a Referrer Account ID and why do I need one?
items.answer: A Referrer ID is a unique code used during the sign-up process. It is required to ensure you are accurately placed within our network and matched with the correct senior coach. This ID establishes a direct mentorship link so you have immediate support from an experienced user from day one.

items.question: Can I create multiple accounts?
items.answer: No, setting up multiple accounts is strictly prohibited unless expressly permitted in writing by our compliance team. To maintain fair quota distribution across our network and adhere to AML regulations, users cannot create different accounts under the same identity or use aliases to bypass daily limits.

items.question: Can I delete my account?
items.answer: Yes, you have the right to close your account at any time. However, you may not close or delete your account while there are any pending operations, active cycles, or outstanding shortfalls. All financial ledgers must be fully settled and cleared before an account deletion request can be successfully processed.

items.question: Is my personal data and platform activity encrypted?
items.answer: Yes. Strict data privacy is our absolute priority. All sensitive user data, including personal identifiers, financial ledgers, and payout credentials, are secured using military-grade AES-256 encryption both in transit and at rest. Furthermore, our architecture includes a Data Firewall for edge protection and a Semantic Guard to proactively filter network threats.

items.question: Is the platform compliant with GDPR and CCPA data privacy laws?
items.answer: Yes. We are strictly compliant with major international data privacy regulations, including the GDPR (Europe) and CCPA (California). We only collect the minimal data necessary for AML/KYC legal compliance and platform operations. We guarantee that we will never sell your personal or financial information to third-party data brokers.

items.question: Who owns the intellectual property of the structural products I process?
items.answer: All intellectual property rights for the structural products, processed data sets, and resulting ledgers remain the exclusive, confidential property of the Company and our merchant partners. Users are generously compensated for their processing and validation efforts, but they do not retain any ownership, copyright, or licensing rights over the data itself.

items.question: Can I export my processed product history?
items.answer: No. Due to strict Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs) and confidentiality contracts with our merchant partners, the data you process is considered highly proprietary. To prevent corporate espionage or data leaks, users are technically restricted from exporting, downloading, or scraping their product processing history.

items.question: What is a Payout Passphrase and why is it required?
items.answer: Your Payout Passphrase acts as your private financial key. It is a mandatory, secondary layer of authorization required to approve any standard payout request. This ensures that even in the highly unlikely event that your main account password is compromised, malicious actors cannot transfer your hard-earned ledger funds without this secondary key.

items.question: I forgot my password, how do I recover my account?
items.answer: If you have lost access to your account, you must contact our support team through the secure portal. Because we deal with financial ledgers, you will be required to verify your identity (often via KYC document submission) before we can issue a manual reset. This strict process prevents social engineering and unauthorized account takeovers.

items.question: What exactly are the active "Assignments"?
items.answer: Assignments are the core work you perform on the platform, consisting of Automated Data Processing and Financial Ledger product allocations. When you start an assignment, you establish a secure connection to our allocation pool to synchronize a structural product, verify the dataset for accuracy, and upload it to the ledger. This process validates merchant data and generates your asset yield.

items.question: What is required to start or reset a cycle?
items.answer: To ensure users have sufficient liquidity to process high-value products, every cycle requires a minimum ledger balance of $100 to initiate for every cycles. You cannot trigger a cycle reset while you are currently in the middle of an active cycle.

items.question: Can I skip, remove, or reverse an active product assignment?
items.answer: No. Once an assignment is synchronized to your dashboard, it is strictly bound to your current cycle. Assignments cannot be skipped, removed, reversed, or bypassed under any circumstances. You must complete the validation process to advance to the next product.

items.question: What happens if I hold a product for too long?
items.answer: If an assignment is synced but retained without being uploaded for longer than 48 hours, it clogs the allocation pool and actively delays our merchant partners' progress. In these instances, nominal fees may be levied from your ledger to cover administrative costs, and standard payment schedules may be adjusted due to the breach of operational speed.

items.question: Why do I sometimes receive corrupted files?
items.answer: Occasionally, the raw data provided by merchants contains unreadable or broken fragments, resulting in a corrupted file. These files are not eligible to generate any yield. However, because the system still had to allocate server resources to fetch and assign the data to you, it will consume one of your available products for that cycle.

items.question: What are your standard operating hours?
items.answer: Our primary support and processing operations, including manual payout reviews and KYC audits, run from Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM EST. This aligns with traditional global banking hours. Weekend availability (Saturday and Sunday) may fluctuate based on scheduled system maintenance and active queue volumes.

items.question: How do I contact the customer support team?
items.answer: For the fastest and most secure resolution, you can reach our dedicated support team directly through the live chat widget located on your dashboard. This ensures you are communicating from within an authenticated environment, allowing our agents to pull up your account details immediately.

items.question: Does my ledger balance affect the assignments I receive?
items.answer: Yes. Product distribution is algorithmically randomized based on your account's available asset balance. Maintaining a higher asset balance correlates with an increased probability of receiving higher-priced, higher-yielding product allocations.

items.question: What is the role of my assigned coach?
items.answer: Your assigned coach is a highly experienced, senior user of the platform. Their role is to provide you with one-on-one guidance, help you understand the nuances of product operations, and teach you how to optimize your daily assignments. Because of our referral program, they are financially incentivized to see you succeed.

items.question: How is my coach assigned?
items.answer: Your coach is automatically linked to your account during the registration process based entirely on the Referrer Account ID you provided. This direct assignment ensures you have a dedicated point of contact who is already familiar with your onboarding timeline.

items.question: Is my coach responsible for my account's financial performance or shortfalls?
items.answer: No. While your coach is there to provide training, operational guidance, and strategic advice, your account is strictly an individual profile. You maintain full autonomy and responsibility over your own daily assignments, ledger balance, and any potential shortfalls. Your coach does not have access to your personal funds and cannot perform assignments on your behalf.

items.question: What is a Shortfall and how do I resolve it?
items.answer: A shortfall occurs when you are assigned a premium, high-yield product that exceeds the current value of your ledger tier. To process this high-value assignment and generate the associated premium yield, you must temporarily bridge the gap. To resolve a shortfall, contact our live support team to receive instructions on depositing the exact required funds. Deposits can be securely made via traditional fiat channels or supported blockchain networks.

items.question: How long do deposits take to reflect in my account?
items.answer: Deposit times depend heavily on the blockchain network congestion or bank processing speeds. However, once you have successfully completed the transfer and provided the transaction receipt to our live support team, the funds will typically reflect in your total ledger balance within 15 to 30 minutes following standard network verification.

items.question: Can I deposit funds to skip my daily quotas?
items.answer: No. The core function of our business is actual data processing, not pure capital investment. Deposits are strictly utilized for starting/resetting a new cycle or clearing an active premium shortfall. You cannot pay money to bypass the mandatory manual validation work.

items.question: How is the Asset Yield calculated?
items.answer: Asset yield is strictly tiered based on your active membership level. For standard product assignments, the yield rate is 1%, 1.5%, 2%, or 2.5%. If you receive a consolidated package assignment, the yield is set at a fixed 5%.

items.question: What is a cycle and how many products does it have?
items.answer: One complete product cycle consists of 40/45/50/55 products (dependings on membership levels). We enforce a strict limit of 2 full cycles per single day. This limitation prevents user burnout, maintains high data validation accuracy, and ensures a fair distribution of work across our entire global network.

items.question: What happens if I don't finish all 40 quotas in one sitting?
items.answer: You are absolutely not required to complete a full 40-quota cycle in a single sitting. You can pause your work and resume at your convenience. However, remember the 48-hour rule: you must not hold an active, synced assignment for more than 48 hours to ensure merchant processing pipelines are not delayed.

items.question: Do my earnings compound automatically?
items.answer: No, your earnings do not mathematically compound cycle-over-cycle. Each new cycle resets the base metrics to maintain predictable costs for our merchants. However, all generated yield from previous cycles will safely remain accumulating in your total ledger balance until you successfully request a final payout.

items.question: What are packages?
items.answer: During a standard cycle, the system may randomly allocate 0 to 3 consolidated packages. Within each package, you will receive 1 to 3 products that must be processed simultaneously. Because these require more processing effort, package assignments grant a fixed 5% premium yield.

items.question: How do I claim the Welcome Bonus?
items.answer: To help you cover your initial cycle thresholds faster, a $20.00 Welcome Bonus is automatically credited to your available ledger balance immediately upon successful registration. There are no extra steps, hidden forms, or waiting periods required to claim it.

items.question: How does the Attendance Milestone Tracker work?
items.answer: We highly value consistent data processors. By completing your daily assignments every single day, you build an uninterrupted attendance streak. As you hit specific milestones (such as Day 7, Day 14, etc.), the system automatically unlocks scheduled base payouts that are credited directly to your balance.

items.question: What is the Full Attendance KPI?
items.answer: If you achieve perfect attendance by completing all daily assignments without missing a single day within the current month, you unlock the Full Attendance KPI. This applies a massive, automatic multiplier to your total accumulated base payouts for that cycle, rewarding our most reliable users. (Note: This multiplier applies to base payouts only, not to other varying yields).

items.question: What happens if I miss a day of assignments?
items.answer: Because our merchants rely on consistent daily volume, failing to complete your cycle for the day will break your active attendance streak. This means you will miss out on the Full Attendance KPI multiplier for that month and will need to restart your progress toward the next milestone from day one.

items.question: What are Limited-Time Bonus Events?
items.answer: During periods of unusually high merchant demand, we run special promotional events that offer exclusive, increased rewards. These events appear dynamically on your dashboard for a limited duration. You should check the Promotions section regularly before they expire so you don't miss out on peak earning windows!

items.question: Can I upgrade my membership level?
items.answer: Yes. If your account executes a single qualifying deposit to clear a shortfall while actively processing assignments, and you concurrently meet the prerequisites of an active promotional event, your account will automatically be upgraded to a higher membership tier.

items.question: Do I earn a commission for referring new users?
items.answer: Yes! We prefer to reinvest our advertising budget back into our community. If you participate in our optional referral program, you earn a 20% referral commission based on the profits generated by your direct referral. This 20% is subsidized entirely out of the Company's pockets, meaning your referee still keeps 100% of their own earnings.

items.question: Is this a multi-level marketing (MLM) structure?
items.answer: No, absolutely not. Our referral structure is strictly one-to-one (1-on-1). You only earn commissions from the direct user you referred and trained. We do not support multi-level marketing, pyramids, or tiered commission structures because we want to encourage genuine, direct mentorship.

items.question: Who is eligible to participate in the referral program?
items.answer: To ensure our referrers actually understand the platform before they attempt to teach others, you must accumulate a total of 14 days of active attendance before you are authorized to generate a referral ID. To maintain high-quality mentorship, there is also a mandatory 14-day cooldown period between each successful referral you make.

items.question: Why is my referral commissions paused?
items.answer: Referral commissions are active only when your Referee's account is in good standing. If your referee gets stuck and leaves an assignment in a "pending" state, your 20% referral commission from their account will be temporarily paused. This rule exists to motivate coaches to actively help their referees clear hurdles. Once they upload the pending assignment, your commission resumes immediately.

items.question: Are there specific conditions before I can request a payout?
items.answer: Yes. To maintain strict ledger stability and ensure merchant daily quotas are fulfilled before capital exits the ecosystem, you must complete all active assignments within your current cycle. You must also ensure there are no outstanding balances or shortfalls on your account. Payouts strictly cannot be processed mid-cycle.

items.question: Is there a minimum payout amount?
items.answer: Yes, the minimum payout amount is $10. This minimum is enforced because the platform absorbs the cost of network gas fees and administrative banking overhead for your transactions, which is financially unviable for micro-transactions under $20.

items.question: Are there transaction volume limits for standard payouts?
items.answer: To maintain ledger stability, payout capacities are aligned with your active membership tier. Standard Basic accounts can process up to $5,000; Premium accounts up to $50,000; Exclusive accounts up to $100,000; and VIP accounts have an unrestricted, unlimited payout capacity.

items.question: Are there any payout fees?
items.answer: We do not charge any internal payout fees or percentages on your balances. Furthermore, we cover the crypto network gas fees for tokenized payouts to maximize your take-home earnings. However, if you choose traditional fiat banking methods, you are responsible for any international transfer rates applied by your own financial institution.

items.question: How long do payouts typically take?
items.answer: You should submit your payout request within 24 to 48 hours after completing a cycle. Once submitted, payouts often process within an hour, though final settlement times are subject to your receiving financial institution or blockchain network speed. You may also inform our live support team after submitting your request to facilitate processing at the earliest convenience. All requests remain subject to mandatory Anti-Money Laundering (AML) checks and yield verification.

items.question: What payout methods are supported by the platform?
items.answer: We support a globally diversified range of settlement methods tailored to your registered region to ensure maximum flexibility. Options include direct fiat Bank Transfers (such as ACH, SEPA, BACS, and Interac) as well as Tokenized Assets (Cryptocurrency via manual network configuration).

items.question: What happens if I direct a payout to the wrong crypto wallet address or network?
items.answer: Due to the decentralized nature of blockchain technology, cryptocurrency transactions are strictly irreversible. If you send a payout to an incorrect wallet address or select the wrong network, your funds will be permanently lost. We have no technical ability to recover sent tokens, so please double-check your destination details carefully.

items.question: Do I need a non-custodial wallet to receive tokenized payouts?
items.answer: No, a non-custodial wallet is not strictly required. You can use any wallet that supports the specific token and network you select on the payout page. This includes private non-custodial wallets as well as direct deposit addresses from major centralized exchanges.

items.question: Can I request a payout to a bank account under someone else's name?
items.answer: No, under no circumstances. To comply with strict international Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Know Your Customer (KYC) regulations, the legal name on your destination bank account must perfectly match the verified identity on your platform account. Any attempted third-party transfers will trigger a security flag and be automatically rejected.

items.question: Why was my bank transfer rejected or delayed?
items.answer: Fiat banking systems are often slower and more rigid than crypto networks. Bank transfers are typically delayed due to user-entry errors (incorrect routing/account numbers), regional banking holidays, or routine security holds placed by your receiving financial institution. If a transfer hard-fails, the funds will be safely returned to your ledger balance.

items.question: Do you support international wire transfers?
items.answer: While we technically support traditional international wire transfers for certain remote regions, please note that this method is frequently unavailable or subject to extended maintenance due to high failure rates. When it is available, you are entirely responsible for covering any incoming international wire fees charged by intermediary banks.

items.question: What should I do if my dashboard freezes during an active assignment?
items.answer: Don't panic. If your dashboard freezes, your browser crashes, or you lose internet connection, simply refresh the page or log back in. Your progress, including your active product and current ledger balance, is saved securely on our cloud servers in real-time, allowing you to resume exactly where you left off.

items.question: Will I be compensated if a server outage causes me to miss a cycle?
items.answer: No. While we invest heavily in our infrastructure to strive for absolute maximum uptime, we do not provide financial compensation for missed cycles, broken attendance streaks, or expired quotas resulting from temporary, unforeseen server outages or scheduled system maintenance windows.
